identity.description: Xero is cloud accounting software; the Xero Developer Platform offers Accounting and other APIs, SDKs, OAuth 2.0, and MCP servers.
identity.identity_notes: Sources are from developer.xero.com, the official Xero developer portal.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code (standard), PKCE, and client credentials (Custom Connections, premium).
auth.token_refresh: Access tokens last 30 minutes; with offline_access, a refresh token can request a new access token for 60 days, and a new refresh token is issued each time.
auth.scopes_notes: Granular scopes are being introduced; the offline_access scope is needed for refresh tokens. Apps created before 2 March 2026 have until September 2027 to move from broad to granular scopes.

access.production_restrictions: The Starter tier is free but limited to 5 tenants. More connections need the Core tier or above. Plus tier and above require certification. The Journals endpoint, Practice Manager API and Bulk Connections need a security assessment and use case approval, and are available from Advanced. Custom Connections are a premium option (monthly fee on the Xero organisation). Remote MCP needs the Core plan or above, or a demo organisation on Starter.

api.rate_limits: App daily limit: 1,000 calls per day for Starter, 5,000 per day for higher tiers. App minute limit: 10,000 calls per minute.
api.limitations: Monthly egress allotment applies by tier. Starter has a 5-tenant limit.
